'''Grebleips''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Asogian/Legends|Asogian]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brodo Asogi]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] until shortly after the [[Imperial Charter/Legends|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When, in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] called for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], Grebleips and his delegation were present, joining the fracas that ensued throughout the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]]. Shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Grebleips was to fund a survey [[Extragalactic/Legends|outside]] [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], according to the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]. As the war neared its end, he became part of the [[Delegation of 2000]], legislators who filed a [[Petition of 2000|formal protest]] against Valorum's successor, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], for actions they perceived as [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|unconstitutional]]. When Palpatine turned the Republic into the Galactic Empire, [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] Grebleips on charges of conspiracy and [[Treason/Legends|treason]] for plotting with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to remove Palpatine from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|office]].

==Biography==
For a number of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Asogian/Legends|Asogian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Grebleips represented his [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Brodo Asogi]] as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] [[Grand Convocation Chamber]], Grebleips was stationed in a [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]] between the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] and [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] delegations. The Senator kept a delegation of two to three other [[Asogian/Legends|Asogians]] in tow.<ref name="TPM" /> In the days following [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] announcement of a summit to discuss the taxation of trade routes in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Grebleips and his delegates joined the throngs of Senators and Representatives who waited in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building's]] public corridors to entreat the Chancellor for a moment of his time.<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> Within a year the taxation crisis had escalated, and faith was weakening in Valorum's ability to deal with it. In 32 BBY, Grebleips attended a meeting of the Senate at which [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] spoke on behalf of her [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people]], asking for help regarding a recent [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of her world by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Valorum attempted to defer the motion to a committee, and Amidala called for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in his leadership. After conferring amongst themselves, Grebleips' delegation joined the fracas of the gathered senators. The vote was ultimately successful, and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of Naboo was elected as Valorum's successor.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:Brodo_Asogi_Delegation.jpg|Grebleips and the Brodo Asogi delegation in the Galactic Senate.|thumb|left|220px]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Grebleips made headlines with his intention to fund a survey [[Extragalactic/Legends|outside]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="HNN1">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50||Senator Grebleips to fund Extragalactic Survey}}</ref> Later that year, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out, and the Senate granted Palpatine even more power to deal with the crisis.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> As the war went on, a number of legislators in the Senate grew concerned over the amount of power Palpatine was gathering, and his subversion of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]].<ref name="ROTSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> When Palpatine enacted a new system of [[Moff/Legends|regional governors]] to administer the Republic in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Grebleips and nineteen hundred ninety-nine other legislators, calling themselves the [[Delegation of 2000]], filed a [[Petition of 2000|formal protest]] in a session of the Senate. It was not successful; after the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] attempted to remove him from power, Palpatine [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|exterminated]] them and [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] the Republic a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under a new [[Imperial Charter/Legends|charter]], with himself as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Along with sixty-two other Senators, Grebleips was [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], charged with conspiracy and treason for helping plot the Jedi coup.<ref name="HNN2">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Grebleips responded to Queen Amidala's Vote of No Confidence in Chancellor Valorum by lifting his arms.<ref name="TPM" /> The Senator would later on join the Delegation of 2000 protesting Chancellor Palpatine's emergency powers.<ref name="HNN2" /> Grebleips had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin and no [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|If even E.T. has fallen to Emperor Palpatine, the galaxy is in dire straights ''[sic]'' indeed.|''[[Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000]]''|<ref name="Who">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref>}}
[[File:Greb_in_Senate.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The Brodo Asogi delegates in ''Republic 61''.]]
As [[George Lucas]] was making [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], his friend and colleague [[Steven Spielberg]] suggested he include a member of E.T.'s species&mdash;from Spielberg's film [https://ettheextraterrestrial.fandom.com/wiki/E.T._the_Extra-Terrestrial_(film) ''E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial'']&mdash;as a background character.<ref name="LA">David Bloom (1999-06-13). "Calling the shots", [[Wikipedia:Los Angeles Daily News|Los Angeles Daily News]]</ref> Spielberg himself had included a character in a [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] costume in ''E.T.'' When Spielberg's hero sees the Yoda mask, he says "Home!" This prompted a fan theory that E.T. is from the same galaxy as Yoda's kind. Three members of E.T.'s species were placed in the movie in a shot of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], as an [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]]. When [[James Luceno]] wrote ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', he expanded on the in-joke by naming the character of Grebleips&mdash;"Spielberg" [[Tuckerization|spelled backwards]]&mdash;and giving him the homeworld of Brodo Asogi, a name given to E.T.'s planet in the spin-off novel ''E.T.: The Book of the Green Planet''.<ref name="Who" /> [[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'']] took the references to ''E.T.'' further, adding a brief note about Grebleips funding an expedition outside the galaxy. Members of the Brodo Asogi delegation appear in the background of [[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]], seemingly as another Easter egg appearance, but it is not clear whether any of them are Grebleips.
